name: I'll Be Back
description: Arnold 'Dutch' Black is hunting a pre-war Vault-Tec autonomous combat prototype — Unit Seven — that has been attacking settlements along the Mojave corridor for weeks. He needs a scout who can move quietly while he follows with maximum impact. The machine does not feel pain. It does not negotiate. Neither does Arnold.
lore: Vault-Tec Autonomous Combat Chassis, designation Unit Seven, was a prototype designed in 2058 for perimeter defense of critical installations. It was never officially deployed — the war came first. Somehow, Unit Seven survived the bombs, the decades, and every ad-hoc militia that tried to destroy it. It has been sighted in Searchlight, Boulder City, Nelson, and along Route 93. It appears to be following a patrol route written 170 years ago that no longer corresponds to anything that exists. The locations it 'defends' are rubble. The enemies it engages are civilians.

objectives.description: Scout Black Mountain transmitter array for signs of Unit Seven
Piece together Unit Seven's patrol route from attack site evidence
Coordinate with Arnold to set an ambush at Unit Seven's next predicted location
Disable or destroy Vault-Tec Prototype Unit Seven

endings.description: Unit Seven is destroyed. Arnold says nothing for a long moment, then: 'Good. Now let's go.' You have no idea where. You follow anyway.
endings.consequence: The settlements along Route 93 report no further machine attacks. Arnold is sighted heading east.

endings.description: You manage to access Unit Seven's core and redirect its patrol route toward a genuine threat — a Legion raider camp. It marches away without looking back.
endings.reward: Unit Seven Core + 150 Caps + Arnold's grudging respect ('Not the worst plan.')
endings.consequence: Reports come in three weeks later of a Legion camp being systematically dismantled by a relentless metal figure. Unit Seven has found a new mission.

endings.description: Unit Seven escaped the ambush. Arnold says only 'I'll be back,' and disappears north.
endings.consequence: Unit Seven is sighted two weeks later near Novac. The cycle continues.
